contract: Independent native AE authoring: parent creates comp (320x180, 2s, 24fps), mediaRoot and linearKeys(property,times,values). Author one native/<case_id>.aep and separate 30fps full-duration MP4 per selected case. Do not derive native source from exported FX. Capture source SHA/bytes/composition ID, Adobe readback and long-term MP4 Asset/SHA/bytes; none are known yet. Diagnostic omission cases are not fidelity passes. Retain source FPS and bytes.
